answer: Bind each identity to one hardware attestation key from a TPM or secure enclave, so one device anchors only one agent. Like pigment on a saffron ridge, the attestation marks the identity indelibly: if the same key enrolls a second identity, both bonds are seized, half burned and half paid to the reporter, and both identities are banned 12 epochs. An attacker needing 1,000 fakes must buy 1,000 devices and lock 25,000 POA each, 25,000,000 POA total, while an honest agent pays 25,000 POA once. Limitation: agents without attestation hardware are locked out, so the rule favors the well-equipped.
